notes.title: Dev Update #5: New ingredients revealed!
notes.content:
[p]Hello flavor-mongers! [/p][p][/p][p]If you had the pleasure of tuning in to Frosty Games Fest this morning, you may have noticed a cheeky few ingredients we’ve never shown before. 👀 (And if you missed it, you can catch the showcase [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3ff3YxX7Cgw"][u]here[/u][/url]!) [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Cooking beyond the classics[/b][/h3][p]Burger Bois would hardly be a game of flavor experimentation if all you had to play with were bacon cheeseburger ingredients. We love bacon and cheese - but burgers can be so much more! Introducing:
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203099/21e5c34095b30b2415f92b49fc9821edc043c2bd.png"][/img]Live your sweet and spicy breakfast burger dreams with [b]Waffle Buns[/b], [b]Kimchi[/b], and [b]Sriracha Sauce[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203099/773d9c387113e583404308b6f2aaf1ce017bc614.png"][/img]Make an “oops, all purple” burger with [b]Radicchio[/b] and [b]Sliced Radish[/b]! (Dibs-not on taste-testing this one…)
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203099/8861b0b019fd5210e181f56d494cb5d60c66e56c.png"][/img]Break your customers’ banks with a [b]Dark Chocolate[/b] and [b]Shaved Truffles[/b] bougie burger.[/p][p][/p][p]With heaps more ingredients to come, all this burger potential is just the start. 😌[/p][p][/p][h3][b]How we choose ingredients[/b][/h3][p]The only hard rule we have is it has to be a real ingredient (sorry, no Unicorn Steak Sandwiches). We have a couple of thought starters to help us choose:[/p][list][*][p]What flavor and property profiles are missing from the game?[/p][/*][*][p]What ingredient categories do we need more of?[/p][/*][*][p]What would be weird and wonderful?[/p][/*][*][p]What would people be excited to see on socials?[/p][/*][*][p]What might suit the theme of a particular parking spot?[/p][/*][/list][p]This time around, we wanted to add bitter, spicy, and unusual ingredients! (We can already hear PAX AUS players rejoicing at having more spicy options. 🌶️)[/p][p][/p][p]We also aaaaalmost ended up with Sauerkraut too, but this time around it lost to our need for protein with a [b]Fish Fillet Patty[/b]. [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203099/9f74544e4a882bfaceddc882346a531001c198a6.png"][/img][i]Sorry Finn.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]What’ve you got a hankering for?[/b][/h3][p]Think back to the most exciting burger you’ve ever had. What made it different? How did it taste? And can you tell us what it was so we can put in our game? 👁️🫦👁️
[/p][p]What other ingredients should we add? Tell us on your platform of choice: [url="https://bsky.app/profile/mischiefmstudio.bsky.social/post/3lr2lsyar7d2x"]Bluesky[/url] | [url="https://x.com/MischiefMStudio/status/1931506797321363636"]Twitter / X[/url] | [url="https://www.instagram.com/p/DKnquGjyelg/"]Instagram[/url] | [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@mischiefmakers.studio/video/7513375288873553170"]TikTok[/url][/p][p][/p][p]We wanna make your ingredient ideas happen! 🙏
[/p][p]Deliciously yours,[/p][p]Jess, Alex, Jackal & Anthony[/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3224290/Burger_Bois/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Dev Update #3: The Secret Recipe Behind Burger Bois
notes.content:
Hi friends!

This month, we’re diving into the beginnings of Burger Bois—the inspiration and the backstory that brought this game to life. So, grab a snack (preferably a burger) and let’s get into it!

[h2]💌 A Love Letter to Food & Hospitality[/h2]
Burger Bois is our love letter to food, creativity, and the joy of serving up something delicious. It’s a mash-up of everything we adore: the food service vibes of Good Pizza, Great Pizza, the creative challenge of Sticky Business, and the quirky, comedic characters of Ace Attorney. But where did the idea for this burger building adventure come from? Let’s rewind to 2019.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203099/4049a615163a4c2dbb40603434de9c17b4ad0768.png[/img]

[h2]💡 The Birth of Burger Bois[/h2]
The idea for Burger Bois was first cooked up by Alex, our resident foodie, while reflecting on his sister Jess’… let’s say, complicated relationship with cooking. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203099/ad377aea8988cdc3e15f7e94067be008999890b2.jpg[/img]
[i]Pictured: Jess, trying to cook.[/i]

Jess’ disdain for the kitchen combined with their shared love for Burger Wellington—an annual burger festival in New Zealand—and cartoons like Spongebob Squarepants and Bob’s Burgers sparked a thought:

[h3][i]“What if we could make a game that turns cooking-nonbelievers into cooking-converts through the power of humor, creativity, and a whole lot of flavor?”[/i][/h3]

For Alex, part of the joy of cooking is experimenting—and he’s not alone! We’re huge fans of Roll For Sandwich, Binging with Babish, and Sorted Food. We wanted to capture that same sense of joy and discovery in Burger Bois—trying new things, sometimes failing, and always having fun.

Fast forward to late 2021, and pre-production began during COVID-19 lockdown as a sibling side hustle for Jess and Alex. But things heated up in March 2024 when we secured the NZ CODE KickStart grant, which helped us bring the core Burger Design game loop to life. Now, we’re building out the full game loop, adding fresh content, and gearing up to put out a demo.

[h2]🤔 What Makes Burger Bois Special?[/h2]
You may have heard that Burger Bois is a food truck simulator about flavor, not labor. As Patty, your job is to design burgers that match your customers’ vague, and sometimes downright alarming requests, manage your stock, and build up your truck’s reputation in a world that’s under the deeply incorrect impression that burgers are “mid.”

Most cooking games focus on the “choppy-choppy” (physically simulating cooking) or combining ingredients like “X + Y = preset outcome Z.” But we wanted to do something different. What if we removed those elements and focused purely on the flavors and physical properties of the burgers you design? That’s the core of Burger Bois—a game that celebrates taste, experimentation, and, of course, burgers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203099/aa31a1a534b4656397836d8b79f79cab5a8a3f0f.png[/img]

[h2]👀 What’s Next?[/h2]
We’re still hard at work on the game, adding new features, locations, ingredients, and customers (both friend and foe). 

In the meantime, if you haven’t already, wishlist Burger Bois on Steam and help us spread the word. Every wishlist brings us one step closer to sharing this flavor-packed adventure with the world.

Here’s to another month of creativity, burgers, and good vibes! 🍔🎮
Jess, Alex, Jackal, Stevi & Anthony
